testcase.system-out: Scenario: sweep-02 Create and traverse a sweep history ✔ Given a disposable copy of the native fixture "fixtures/cad/sweep/circle-straight-path.opd" is open ✔ And its circle profile and straight path sketches are visible ✔ When Sweep is invoked ✔ Then the panel shows 1 Profile and 1 Curve ✔ And a solid preview and enabled OK are displayed ✔ When OK is clicked ✔ Then Sweep1 and Solid Bodies(1) appear ✔ When Undo is invoked ✔ Then the two sketches return without the solid ✔ When Redo is invoked ✔ Then Sweep1 and its solid return
